strings.zh: 想不到会在这里相见啊！{NEWLINE}我是相机大叔彦藏。{SCROLL}上镜的朋友！{NEWLINE}要不要来一张照片呢？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hello, just when you least expect it!{NEWLINE}I am Cameron the Photographer.{SCROLL}You look so photogenic!{NEWLINE}Why not have a picture taken? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 很好很好！{NEWLINE}照片拍得不错！{SCROLL}拍下的照片可以在电脑上看到呢~
strings.en: Good, good!{NEWLINE}We’ve got a nice picture!{SCROLL}You can see all the pictures{NEWLINE}on your PC.

strings.zh: 啊！等一下！{SCROLL}我超人般的直觉告诉我{NEWLINE}现在你的相册{CLEAR}似乎是已经满了啊！{SCROLL}不好意思,等你先去{NEWLINE}电脑上整理一下照片后{CLEAR}再来找我吧~
strings.en: Wait a second!{SCROLL}My superhuman ability is telling me{NEWLINE}that your Photo Album{CLEAR}is full!{SCROLL}Sorry to trouble you, but{NEWLINE}can you delete some pictures{CLEAR}before you talk to me again?

strings.zh: 哦呀哦呀？{NEWLINE}你没有相册啊。{SCROLL}要整理拍到的照片{NEWLINE}就一定要有相册啊。{SCROLL}我满金市的哥哥那有,{NEWLINE}你去那里拿一个相册吧~
strings.en: Hmmm...{NEWLINE}You don’t seem to have a Photo Album.{SCROLL}You need one to sort the pictures{NEWLINE}you’ve taken.{SCROLL}My big brother in Goldenrod City has{NEWLINE}some, so why not go and get one?
strings.notes: US 0030/4 | RV069: addition: US added the photo-studio detail; zh only says the brother in Goldenrod has one

strings.zh: 这儿有台自动相机,{SCROLL}要拍张照片吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: There is an automatic camera.{SCROLL}Do you want to take a picture? {VAR:0200:0}
It will proceed to take a picture.{SCROLL}
It has taken a picture successfully.

strings.zh: 你的相册的照片满了。{SCROLL}等整理完照片后再来吧~
strings.en: The Photo Album is full.{SCROLL}Please delete some pictures before you{NEWLINE}come back.

strings.zh: 我找不到你的相册。{SCROLL}等你在满金市的地下通道{NEWLINE}拿到相册后再来吧。
strings.en: I can’t find your Photo Album.{SCROLL}Please come back after you get one{NEWLINE}in the Goldenrod City Underground.
strings.notes: US 0030/10 | RV069: meaning: zh says get it in Goldenrod’s Underground (D-0990), not a vague tunnel
